result.title: Wonder 4: A Mixture-of-Experts Recipe for Image Quality Enhancement
result.comment: Full version will be released soon
result.summary: A real photograph is often blurry, grainy, compressed, scratched, and low-resolution at the same time. Each defect has its own severity and its own place in the image. The corrections for these defects conflict with each other. Exist- ing models describe the whole image with one description, so they cannot say where each correction belongs. To solve this problem, we present Wonder 4, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model for image quality enhancement. It corrects several defects of a real photograph at the same time, each in the region where it occurs. Every block of the model holds a mixture of N = 13 experts. A router, trained with the model, sends every image patch to k = 5 of them. No degradation classifier, mask, prompt, detector, or task label is used. Another issue is that standard MoE training, taken from language models, pushes every expert toward equal use. Equal use applies every correction everywhere, even where it is not needed. We replace this rule with a bias that only sets a minimum share of use. Across all patches, an expert used less than this minimum gets higher router scores until it is selected again. An expert above the minimum is not changed, so no expert is forced to be used as often as the others. The bias needs no extra loss. The method adds no extra module and no extra processing step. We evaluate Wonder 4 on DIV2K and Flickr2K, against five published methods and three open-weight pipelines. It reaches the best LPIPS, DISTS, and NIQE on all three test settings (DIV2K x4, DIV2K x8, and Flickr2K x4).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Wonder 4，一个用于同时修复真实照片多种缺陷的 MoE 图像增强模型：每个 block 含 13 个专家，由 router 将每个 image patch 分派给其中 5 个，不使用退化分类器、掩码、提示或任务标签；并用只设定最低使用份额的偏置替代语言模型式的等量使用约束，在 DIV2K/Flickr2K 三个测试设置上取得最优 LPIPS、DISTS、NIQE。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐 patch 的隐式路由加「只设下限、不强求均衡」的专家使用偏置，可能为 LVR 中按视觉区域稀疏分配专家与计算、缓解专家坍缩提供可核查线索；但任务属低层图像修复，本身不涉及推理状态或证据使用。
